pools.reading: slots 7..17 are shared with every other command-4 / badnik allocation: a busy screen creates fewer shards (the first k of the four in the order offsets 0, 8, 16, 24 with parameters 3, 8, 5, 1).  A child created in a slot BELOW its parent's runs its state-0 callback one pass later (the scheduler already passed that slot), so its whole shard timeline is one update later.  Shards are cosmetic: nothing reads them
